reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program (Oklahoma, focus year 2021)
    Question: Must an eviction (forcible entry and detainer) summons mention legal services info?
*/

/* =========================
   Scenario (facts)
   ========================= */

% The question context
scenario_state(oklahoma).
scenario_focus_year(2021).
scenario_action(forcible_entry_and_detainer).
scenario_document(eviction_summons).
scenario_served_to(tenant).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the scenario is established.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(oklahoma),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_action(forcible_entry_and_detainer),
    scenario_document(eviction_summons),
    scenario_served_to(tenant).

/* =========================
   Statutes translated to predicates
   ========================= */

/* --- 12 OK Stat  12-1148.4 (2021)
   Summons requirements in forcible entry and detainer actions:
   - command service to summon defendant to appear for trial at specified time/place
   - time: not less than 5 days nor more than 10 days from date issued
   - apprise defendant of nature of claim
   - endorse relief sought and amount plaintiff will take judgment for if defendant fails to appear
*/
statute_12_1148_4_required_element(command_to_appear_for_trial).
statute_12_1148_4_required_element(time_and_place_specified).
statute_12_1148_4_required_element(nature_of_claim_apprised).
statute_12_1148_4_required_element(relief_sought_endorsed).
statute_12_1148_4_required_element(default_judgment_amount_endorsed).

% Encodes the statutory timing constraint (5 to 10 days after issuance).
% This is included for completeness, though not needed to answer the legal-services question.
statute_12_1148_4_trial_date_ok(DaysFromIssue) :-
    integer(DaysFromIssue),
    DaysFromIssue >= 5,
    DaysFromIssue =< 10.

/* --- 12 OK Stat  12-1148.16 (2021)
   Provides a required "form" of summons for forcible entry and detainer, including the notices.
   We encode the substantive informational items appearing in the statutory form.
*/
statute_12_1148_16_form_element(direct_to_relinquish_or_appear_show_cause).
statute_12_1148_16_form_element(property_description).
statute_12_1148_16_form_element(hearing_building_name_or_address).
statute_12_1148_16_form_element(hearing_county).
statute_12_1148_16_form_element(hearing_time).
statute_12_1148_16_form_element(hearing_date).
statute_12_1148_16_form_element(alternate_hearing_three_days_after_service_if_later).
statute_12_1148_16_form_element(minimum_five_days_from_issuance_notice).
statute_12_1148_16_form_element(default_judgment_notice_possession_and_money).
statute_12_1148_16_form_element(writ_of_assistance_notice).
statute_12_1148_16_form_element(costs_and_attorney_fees_may_be_awarded_notice).
statute_12_1148_16_form_element(date_line).
statute_12_1148_16_form_element(clerk_or_judge_signature_line).
statute_12_1148_16_form_element(plaintiff_or_attorney_signature_line).
statute_12_1148_16_form_element(plaintiff_or_attorney_address_line).
statute_12_1148_16_form_element(plaintiff_or_attorney_telephone_number_line).

/* =========================
   Legal reasoning helpers
   ========================= */

% For Oklahoma (2021) forcible entry and detainer summonses, collect all required elements
% that are explicitly stated by the provided statutes.
legal_required_summons_element(oklahoma, 2021, forcible_entry_and_detainer, Element) :-
    statute_12_1148_4_required_element(Element).
legal_required_summons_element(oklahoma, 2021, forcible_entry_and_detainer, Element) :-
    statute_12_1148_16_form_element(Element).

% The specific issue: does the summons have to include legal-services / legal-aid information?
% This succeeds only if "legal_services_information" is among required elements.
legal_services_information_required(State, Year, Action) :-
    legal_required_summons_element(State, Year, Action, legal_services_information).

/* =========================
   Answer predicate
   ========================= */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    scenario_action(Action),
    legal_services_information_required(State, Year, Action),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

/* =========================
   Main entrypoint
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it required that the evictions summons served to tenants mention information on legal services the tenant could leverage (e.g., legal aid or legal services that a tenant could contact to request assistance)?
